ldap_host.description: Hostname or IP of the LDAP server.

ldap_port.description: Port number of the LDAP server.

ldap_base_dn.description: Base Distinguished Name for LDAP searches.

ldap_bind_dn.description: Distinguished Name used to bind to the LDAP server.

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for the LDAP bind DN.

ldap_user_filter.description: LDAP filter for finding user accounts.

ldap_computer_filter.description: LDAP filter for finding computer accounts.

service_enabled.description: Whether the Veyon service is enabled on the host.

key_dir.description: Directory containing RSA keys for authentication.

service_port.description: TCP port used by the Veyon service.
